title: 3.2.2a Lab — Sphere with color
description: Create a Sphere at the origin, give it a color, and spin it on Y — your first non-Cube 3D shape.

steps.title: Create a Sphere
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `sphere = new Sphere(0, 0, 0, 1)` to place a sphere of radius 1 at the origin.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and find the Sphere section for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Give it a color
steps.instructions: Set `sphere.color = 'deepskyblue'` (or any CSS color you like).
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and look up the color property.

steps.title: Spin on Y in draw()
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the rotation property section.
